ideas.pitch: A portable diagnostics dock that tests your drone's battery voltage, ESC continuity, and center-of-gravity balance to prevent on-field disqualification.
ideas.problem_statement: Drone must be airworthy and safely secured, with damaged propellers or loose wiring corrected before flight.
ideas.title: AeroMetric: Pre-Flight Safety & Wiring Diagnostic Pod
ideas.why_it_could_win: Reflects the winning pattern of reliability and hardware safety checks, directly addressing the strict rule that event officials may stop unsafe flights.

ideas.pitch: A modular, standalone gate-tracking sensor unit that wirelessly logs drone passes and calculates adjusted completion times for practice runs.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams will navigate a designated aerial course while demonstrating control, precision, safety, and successful course completion, ranked by adjusted completion time.
ideas.title: GateCount: Ultrasonic & IR Lap Timing Rig
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a critical logistical need for pilot training on unpredictable outdoor courses where official timing equipment may be scarce.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight telemetry attachment that sounds a loud onboard buzzer and logs a warning if the pilot drifts outside the designated flight boundary.
ideas.problem_statement: Participants must remain within the designated areas and intentional interference with another participant's flight is prohibited.
ideas.title: FieldSafe: Drone Telemetry & Boundary Geofence Buzzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets safety compliance judges directly by preventing accidental course boundary breaches and potential disqualifications.

ideas.pitch: A compact balancing jig with an integrated accelerometer to detect and quantify propeller vibration imbalances in under 60 seconds.
ideas.problem_statement: Damaged propellers, loose batteries, or unsafe wiring must be corrected before flight.
ideas.title: QuickProp: Rapid Field Balancing & Vibration Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a practical trackside tool that tackles a frequent cause of drone failure and pilot penalties during time-crunch race events.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight progressive web app for teams to track pre-flight safety inspections, battery health logs, and queue slots for race heats.
ideas.problem_statement: All instructions from the event coordinator must be followed and participants may only arm and disarm in designated areas.
ideas.title: PitLog: Pilot Queue & Safety Checklist Management PWA
ideas.why_it_could_win: Improves event workflow organization for teams under tight schedules, focusing on structured compliance and safety coordination.
